name: Kumano Kodo Iseji: Magose-toge pass
why: The best-kept stone paving of the Iseji route to Kumano, through a dark cypress forest over the Magose pass and down to Owase.
book: Free. JR Kisei line to Kii-Nagashima or Aiga.
dangers: Mossy stones are slippery in rain.

points.name: Magose-toge trailhead
points.note: The roadside rest stop where the stone path starts.

points.name: Magose-toge
points.note: The pass among cypress trees, with stone Buddhas.

points.name: Owase
points.note: A fishing town on its bay.
